definition: Geneware modification of the enteric nervous system that allows the user to maintain accurate time-keeping and situational metabolic awareness without BCI access. Popular among runners and Shelf-dwellers who cannot afford or do not trust networked implants.
origin: Geneware street slang; derived from the biological 'gut feeling' idiom and the Tide Clock reference culture
usage: Tier 1-2 runners, off-grid operatives, anti-BCI communities
example: Kofi doesn't run with a node — strictly Gut Clock, says he doesn't want Axiom knowing when he eats.
